corpus: public authored generated Russian text templates; no private archive
decision: Keep exact as default; this generated text benchmark does not validate archive or visual quality.
limitations: Real BERTA/ORT CPU outputs; texts and OCR-labelled rows are generated, not real OCR or images.
Recall is strict top-10 ID overlap against application exact cosine, not judged semantic relevance; near-ties may reorder.
First call is not OS cold: imports, writes and exact queries may warm caches. Warm native samples are a second full pass; application samples follow that pass.
Native HNSW uses shared canonical prefilter/merge in-process; only IVF includes production child/IPC measurements.
Canonical benchmark SQLite rows are published-vector witnesses, not production chunk/message authorization joins.
RSS is sampled whole candidate process; query child RSS is not included.
Small scopes deliberately test native candidates and separately expose application exact fallback.
Fresh known-nearest probes append query-role vectors to test tail inclusion, not ordinary passage retrieval quality.
No SigLIP image embeddings, audio, actual archive distribution or large-corpus default decision in this report.
Native centroid training has no shared fixed seed; low-probe differences include different coarse partitions, not only HNSW or quantization.
One build per candidate, K=10; no top-100, larger-corpus or OS-cold acceptance.
narrow_date is text-only; native_index_bytes includes the scalar ID index.
